info.title: spools
info.description: The routes examples/spools serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

id.description: What this spool is called. It is unique on the shelf.

colour.description: The colour, in the words the operator uses.

device.description: The device it is loaded on, and absent for a spool nothing is printing from.

grams.description: What is left on the reel, in grams.

Refusal.description: One refusal, as RFC 9457 names it. The client SDK reads this shape: code reaches ApiError.code and detail reaches ApiError.message.

type.description: about:blank, because this module publishes no page per code.

status.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

code.description: The module's own code, such as spools/SPOOL_TAKEN. It is outside the core's registry.

title.description: What went wrong, in one phrase that never varies.

detail.description: What went wrong this time, naming the value that caused it.

retryable.description: Whether sending the same request again could work.

Refused.description: The module refused the call. The status says which rule it met.

get.description: Every spool the module holds, and the principal the host authorized, which is the host's answer and never a header the caller set. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Keep only the spools loaded on this device. Absent answers the whole shelf.

spools.description: The spools, in the order they were added.

principal.description: Who the host says is calling.

post.summary: Add a spool to the shelf
post.description: Keeps one spool and answers the row that was added, with the principal the host authorized. An id the shelf already holds is refused with 409. The host takes operate_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

201.description: The spool is on the shelf.

principal.description: Who the host says is calling.
